title: ProfileRequest
description: Names the repository a profile.get, profile.generate or profile.delete call applies to. The path travels on every call rather than being held as host state, because the host has no notion of a current repository: the renderer owns which one is open, and a stale host-side selection would be a way to write one repository's profile against another's path.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root, as repository.open returned it.
